comments.author: Mei Hua
comments.body: aide cabin by itself doesn't have any special effects, you are thinking about adjutant's cabin which is a ship skill, not a ship part. Ship parts are used to put ship skills onto a boat in addition to the improved performance values each on imparts. Admiral's cabins are used for different ship skills.
